question: Who was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 2025 for his contributions to Indian hockey?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PR Sreejesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Government of India** announced the **Padma Awards 2025** on the eve of the **76th Republic Day**, where legendary hockey goalkeeper **PR Sreejesh** was conferred with the **Padma Bhushan**.
 
• The **Padma Bhushan** is the **third-highest civilian award** in India, recognized for "distinguished service of a high order." **PR Sreejesh** received this honor for his monumental contributions to **Indian hockey** over a career spanning nearly two decades.
 
• Hailing from **Kizhakambalam, Kerala**, **PR Sreejesh** is widely regarded as one of the greatest goalkeepers in the history of the sport, earning the nickname **"The Great Wall of Indian Hockey."**
 
• His career reached a historic peak when he played a crucial role in helping the **Indian Men’s Hockey Team** secure back-to-back **Olympic Bronze Medals** at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics** and the **Paris 2024 Olympics**.
 
• Following the **Paris 2024** campaign, where his stellar saves in the quarter-final against Great Britain and the bronze medal match against Germany were decisive, **Sreejesh** announced his **retirement** from international hockey in **August 2024**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Career and Achievements:**
 
 
• **PR Sreejesh** made his international debut for the senior national team in **2006** at the **South Asian Games** in Colombo.
 
• He served as the **Captain** of the Indian national team, leading them to a silver medal at the **2016 Champions Trophy** and a historic quarter-final appearance at the **2016 Rio Olympics**.
 
• He was awarded the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** in **2021**, India's highest sporting honor, and previously received the **Padma Shri** in **2017**.
 
• In **2021**, he became only the second Indian athlete to win the **World Games Athlete of the Year** award, following Rani Rampal.
 
 
 
• **Other Options Context:**
 
 
• **Harvinder Singh:** A legendary **Para-archer** who made history by winning India's first-ever **Gold Medal** in archery at the **Paris 2024 Paralympic Games**. He was also considered for major honors in **2025**.
 
• **IM Vijayan:** A former **Indian Football** captain and three-time **AIFF Player of the Year**. Known as the "Black Pearl" of Indian football, he is a recipient of the **Arjuna Award**.
 
• **Satyapal Singh:** A renowned **Para-athletics coach** who has been instrumental in training several Indian medalists. He was awarded the **Dronacharya Award** for his coaching excellence.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Padma Awards Structure:** The awards are given in three categories: **Padma Vibhushan** (exceptional and distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (distinguished service of high order), and **Padma Shri** (distinguished service).
 
• **Selection Process:** The **Padma Awards Committee**, constituted by the **Prime Minister** every year, makes the recommendations, which are then approved by the **President of India**.
 
• **Legacy:** At the time of his retirement in **2024**, **PR Sreejesh** had earned over **330 international caps** for India. Post-retirement, he was appointed as the head coach of the **India U-21 Men's Hockey Team** to nurture future talent.
 
• **2025 Statistics:** The **2025 Padma list** highlighted a significant focus on sports icons who brought glory to the nation during the **Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic cycle**, emphasizing India's growing stature in global sports.
